title: WPA Student Operations Backend Schema
source_model: WPA Master Workbook v1.4 structure only; no workbook records copied
purpose: Translate the private operational workbook into a governed backend and administrator-console data model for Virtual Sande Student Desk.

entities.purpose: master student identity and programme status
application, consent and human admission review
attempts, component scores, integrity review and human-confirmed result
eligibility, authorisation, serial, verification and revocation
minimal Virtual Sande activity audit without storing unnecessary conversation content
certificate, assessment, access or payment dispute handling
append-only material changes, approvals and overrides

integrity_rules: Every application student_id must reference an existing student.
Every assessment application_id must reference an authorised application.
Assessment result must be calculated from versioned programme rules and then human-confirmed.
Certificate eligibility is not certificate authorisation.
A certificate requires completion review, assessment pass, human authorisation and registry record.
Certificate serials are generated by the backend and must be unique and immutable.
Revocation changes status but does not delete the credential audit trail.
Financial disputes and academic disputes are separate case types.
Dashboard values are aggregate outputs and never a source of truth.
All privileged overrides require actor, reason, timestamp and previous/new values.
workbook_findings_to_correct_before_migr: Replace public package labels Free, Pro and Academic Pro with approved WPA programme and commercial terminology.
Do not use programme Level 1/2/3 labels in public student-facing copy; use official certificate programme names.
Do not calculate certificate issuance automatically from quiz counts or spreadsheet flags.
Repair and independently verify the four detected Dashboard formula error cells before using workbook KPI output.
Treat workbook dates, thresholds and pricing as draft configuration until Sande approves the current values.
Remove sample personal, institutional and financial records before any workbook sharing or migration.

deployment_boundary.activation_requires: approved_private_backend, security review, privacy review, tests and Sande human authorisation
